high_level_description: The image is a promotional piece for the upcoming film "Maharaj," which is set to premiere on June 14th, 2024. The text at the top of the image provides details about the film, mentioning that it will be produced by Netflix and Yash Raj Films. It highlights that the movie will focus on Karsandas Mulji, a journalist and social reformer from pre-independence India (1862), and will star Jaideep Ahlawat and debutante Junaid Khan.
